chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch 382: Eight Out of Twelve – Ji Ning's Trial for the Eight-Nine Arcane Art
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning's ruthless strategy is revealed! He dismantles the Dongliu Monster Kings, killing eight in a brutal display of power. The Golden-Haired Bear King survives, revealing the truth of Ji Ning's karmic trial for the Eight-Nine Arcane Art.
og_title: Desolate Era 382: The Eight-Nine Arcane Art's Brutal Entry Test
og_description: Witness Ji Ning's calculated massacre of the Dongliu Monster Kings. An epic duel of philosophy and power as he explains his master's trial of sin.
twitter_title: DE Ch. 382: Ji Ning's Trial of Ten Sinners Ends in a Bloody Halftime
twitter_description: Ji Ning drops eight massive sinners in a single fight for the Eight-Nine Arcane Art, but needs two more. What comes next?]

lore_anchors.definition: The collective name for the twelve powerful demon rulers of the Eastern Flow territory, each a Loose Immortal of considerable age.
A complete set of Immortal-ranked top-grade flying swords and a matching sword art, granting Ji Ning's second truebody devastating long-range power.
The leader of the Dongliu Monster Kings, a pragmatic and powerful demon who deliberately avoids karmic sin to survive his tribulations.
A form of cosmic reward earned by a cultivator for killing great beings of sin, which can help them survive their Heavenly Tribulation.
Negative karma that accumulates from killing and acts of cruelty, attracting powerful tribulations and weakening the soul.
A powerful immortal who failed their Heavenly Tribulation and survives in a state of decay, their power increasing with age.
The supreme defensive divine ability beneath the True God level, requiring the death of ten great sinners as a trial to learn.
A specific type of trial in Xianxia where a cultivator must kill beings with heavy karmic sin to prove themselves worthy of an inheritance.
The combined formation the Dongliu Monster Kings use to amplify their collective power, which Ji Ning sabotaged by killing the Firewing Monster King first.
A technique that allows a cultivator to create an independent secondary body, which Ji Ning uses to fight alongside his main body.
The first true immortal stage, a being who has transcended the Three Realms and is not bound by natural lifespan.
A higher tier of immortal, possessing a purified Yang soul, making them vastly more powerful than a standard Celestial Immortal.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Ji Ning only kill eight Monster Kings?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The remaining four, including the Golden-Haired Bear, used powerful escape arts to flee, and Ji Ning couldn't stop them all by himself. He needed to kill ten for his trial.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the Golden-Haired Bear a good guy now?
cultural_notes_faq.a: No, but he's a pragmatic and intelligent demon. He avoids sin to survive his tribulations. He respects Ji Ning's strength and is more of a neutral, powerful force.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What is the Eight-Nine Arcane Art?
cultural_notes_faq.a: It is the ultimate passive defensive divine ability for cultivators below the True God level. It requires no divine power to maintain but is expensive and difficult to train.
